_comment: Recommended follow-up actions by incident type (the 15 types in schema/incident_form.json). Code picks these; the model never writes a procedure. Editable at review. Wording is ours, generic workplace practice, not taken from any one standard.
fire: Have the fire safety officer inspect the area before reuse
Check and recharge any extinguisher that was used
Find the cause and inspect the equipment involved
electrical: Isolate the circuit until an electrician inspects it
Review the inspection record for the circuit
water_leak: Find and repair the source of the leak
Check nearby electrical points for water exposure
Dry the area and check for damage
gas_leak: Keep the area ventilated and free of ignition sources
Have the gas line or cylinder checked before reuse
chemical: Clean up with the spill kit, following the safety data sheet
Check that protective equipment is available and used
slip_trip: Check lighting and floor condition in the area
Make sure first aid was offered
fall_height: Stop work at height in the area until it is made safe
Inspect ladders, scaffolding and fall protection
Make sure medical care was given
struck_by: Secure or restack the material that fell or moved
Review vehicle and storage rules for the area
Make sure first aid was offered
caught_in: Lock out the machine until its guards are checked
Make sure medical care was given
equipment_failure: Tag the equipment out of service
Check whether similar equipment is affected
lift: Take the lift out of service until it is inspected
Review the lift's inspection and load records
structural: Have a structural engineer inspect it
Check nearby structures for similar damage
medical: Make sure medical care was given and the family informed
Check that first aid kits and trained staff are available
security: Review access logs and camera footage
Secure the affected area or asset
other: Review the incident with the safety officer
